name: Christ in the Church: A Volume of Religious Essays
desc: Benson's apologetic study of 1911, 'a volume of religious essays', which argues that the Catholic Church is the continuation of Christ's own life: Part I the thesis, Part II His life and ministry, Part III the Passion and rejection, Part IV the Cross, the Sepulture and the Resurrection, each read as repeated in the Church.
desc_pt: O estudo apologético de Benson (1911), 'um volume de ensaios religiosos', que sustenta que a Igreja Católica é o prolongamento da própria vida de Cristo: a Parte I a tese, a II a vida e o ministério, a III a Paixão e a rejeição, a IV a Cruz, a sepultura e a Ressurreição, cada uma lida como repetida na Igreja.
edition: Christ in the Church: A Volume of Religious Essays (London: Longmans, Green, 1911), Internet Archive full-text OCR (christinchurchv00bens).
manual: Part I: The Thesis: Christ in the Church
IV. A Characteristic of the Public Ministry
